A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Good questions.
Simple answers.

How do I order a TreeBites product?

Choose a product and select “Order on Amazon” or “Buy now”. Your chosen retailer opens in a new tab, where you can check the price, delivery and place your order.

Where can I see the latest price?

Visit the product’s Amazon or Fashinoworld page for the current price, offers and availability. These can vary between retailers.

Where can I find ingredients and storage details?

Check the product packaging and the retailer’s listing for the complete ingredient list, allergens, serving directions and storage instructions before ordering.

Who handles delivery and returns?

The retailer you order from handles payment, shipping, order support and returns. Their terms apply to your purchase.
